title: Structuring an argument
description: Organise a sophisticated argument with clear staging and emphasis.

introduction.headline: Build arguments that land
introduction.body: Master framing, signposting, and cleft structures to highlight key points.
introduction.bodyIt: Padroneggia inquadramento, signal language e strutture cleft per evidenziare i punti chiave.

vocabulary.example: The premise of the argument is that regulation drives quality.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: La premessa dell'argomentazione è che la regolamentazione guida la qualità.

vocabulary.example: Signpost each stage so the audience can follow.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Segnala ogni fase così il pubblico può seguire.

vocabulary.example: It is the lack of evidence that weakens the claim.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: È la mancanza di prove che indebolisce la tesi.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses a cleft for emphasis?
exercises.promptIt: Quale frase usa una cleft per enfasi?
options: It is the methodology that raises concern.
exercises.answer: It is the methodology that raises concern.
exercises.explanation: Cleft sentences foreground one element: It is X that...

exercises.prompt: The ____ of the argument must be stated clearly.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: The ____ of the argument must be stated clearly.
exercises.explanation: A premise is the starting assumption of an argument.

review.tip: Rewrite one flat claim as a cleft sentence for stronger emphasis.
